verdict.rationale: The story asks whether an ai-native user can accomplish everything via a public API that they can do in the UI. There is no evidence of any public Shortwave API, SDK, or API docs — probes for llms.txt, docs markdown, and OpenAPI specs all returned 404s, and no other evidence mentions a developer API. Shortwave's openness is described only in terms of MCP integrations and connecting third-party apps into Shortwave's own AI, not exposing Shortwave's own functionality via API.
